+

+@dataclass
+class Options:
+    paths: list = field(default_factory=list)
+    mode: str = "grid"
+    all_count: int = 0

+    recurse: bool = False
+    tree: bool = False
+    as_files: bool = False
+    level: int | None = None
+    reverse: bool = False
+    sort: str = "name_i"
+    dirs_first: bool = False

+    only_dirs: bool = False
+    only_files: bool = False

+    classify: str = "never"
+    icons: str = "never"

+    no_permissions: bool = False
+    no_filesize: bool = False
+    no_user: bool = False

+    header: bool = False
+    bytes: bool = False
+    binary: bool = False
+    inode: bool = False
+    links: bool = False
+    group: bool = False
+    numeric: bool = False
+    time_style: str = "default"
+    time_field: str = "modified"
+    dereference: bool = False
+    follow: bool = False
+
+
+class EzaError(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+def die_option(msg):
+    sys.stderr.write(f"eza: {msg}\n")
+    return 3
+
+
+def add_flag(opt, name, value=True):
+    if name == "all":
+        opt.all_count += 1
+    elif name == "almost_all":
+        opt.almost_all = True
+    elif name == "sort":
+        if value not in SORT_ALIASES:
+            raise EzaError(f"Option --sort (-s) has no {value!r} setting (choices: name, Name, size, extension, Extension, modified, accessed, created, changed, inode, type, none)")
+        opt.sort = SORT_ALIASES[value]
+    elif name == "ignore_glob":
+        opt.ignore_globs.extend(str(value).split("|"))
+    elif name == "level":
+        try:
+            opt.level = int(str(value), 10)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise EzaError(f"Value {str(value)!r} not valid for option --level (-L): {e}")
+    elif name == "width":
+        try:
+            opt.width = max(1, int(str(value), 10))
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise EzaError(f"Value {str(value)!r} not valid for option --width (-w): {e}")
+    elif name == "time_style":
+        opt.time_style = str(value)
+    elif name == "time":
+        val = str(value)
+        if val not in ("modified", "changed", "accessed", "created"):
+            raise EzaError(f"Option --time (-t) has no {val!r} setting (choices: modified, changed, accessed, created)")
+        opt.time_field = val
+    elif name in ("modified", "changed", "accessed", "created"):
+        opt.time_field = name
+    elif name == "classify":
+        opt.classify = str(value)
+    elif name == "icons":
+        opt.icons = str(value)
+    elif name == "color":
+        opt.color = str(value)
+    elif hasattr(opt, name):
+        setattr(opt, name, bool(value))
+
+
+def parse(argv):
+    opt = Options()
+    i = 0
+    parsing = True
+    while i < len(argv):
+        arg = argv[i]
+        if not parsing or arg == "-" or not arg.startswith("-"):
+            opt.paths.append(arg); i += 1; continue
+        if arg == "--":
+            parsing = False; i += 1; continue
+        if arg.startswith("--"):
+            body = arg[2:]
+            val = None
+            if "=" in body:
+                body, val = body.split("=", 1)
+            if body not in LONG_FLAGS:
+                raise EzaError(f"Unknown argument --{body}")
+            name, takes = LONG_FLAGS[body]
+            if takes is True:
+                if val is None:
+                    i += 1
+                    if i >= len(argv):
+                        raise EzaError(f"Flag --{body} needs a value")
+                    val = argv[i]
+                add_flag(opt, name, val)
+            elif takes == "optional":
+                add_flag(opt, name, val if val is not None else "auto")
+            else:
+                if val is not None:
+                    raise EzaError(f"Flag --{body} cannot be passed a value")
+                add_flag(opt, name)
+            i += 1; continue
+        cluster = arg[1:]
+        j = 0
+        while j < len(cluster):
+            ch = cluster[j]
+            if ch not in SHORT_FLAGS:
+                raise EzaError(f"Unknown argument -{ch}")
+            name, takes = SHORT_FLAGS[ch]
+            if takes is True:
+                val = cluster[j + 1:]
+                if val.startswith("="):
+                    val = val[1:]
+                if not val:
+                    i += 1
+                    if i >= len(argv):
+                        raise EzaError(f"Flag -{ch} needs a value")
+                    val = argv[i]
+                add_flag(opt, name, val)
+                break
+            elif takes == "optional":
+                val = cluster[j + 1:] or "auto"
+                add_flag(opt, name, val)
+                break
+            else:
+                add_flag(opt, name)
+            j += 1
+        i += 1
+    opt.long = opt.long or (opt.tree and not opt.grid and not opt.oneline)
+    if opt.oneline:
+        opt.mode = "lines"
+    elif opt.long:
+        opt.mode = "details"
+    elif opt.tree:
+        opt.mode = "details"
+    else:
+        opt.mode = "grid"
+    if not opt.paths:
+        opt.paths = ["."]
+    return opt
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Entry:
+    path: str
+    name: str
+    st: os.stat_result | None
+    lst: os.stat_result | None
+    parent: str | None = None
+    is_dot: bool = False
+
+    def is_link(self): return self.lst is not None and stat.S_ISLNK(self.lst.st_mode)
+    def is_dir(self): return self.st is not None and stat.S_ISDIR(self.st.st_mode)
+    def is_file(self): return self.st is not None and stat.S_ISREG(self.st.st_mode)
+    def points_to_dir(self): return self.is_dir()
+    def size(self): return 0 if self.is_dir() else (self.st.st_size if self.st else 0)
+    def mtime(self): return self.st.st_mtime if self.st else 0
+    def ctime(self): return self.st.st_ctime if self.st else 0
+    def atime(self): return self.st.st_atime if self.st else 0
+    def ext(self):
+        base = self.name.rsplit(os.sep, 1)[-1]
+        if "." not in base or base.startswith(".") and base.count(".") == 1:
+            return ""
+        return base.rsplit(".", 1)[1]
+    def type_char_sort(self):
+        if self.is_dir(): return "d"
+        if self.is_link(): return "l"
+        if self.is_file(): return "f"
+        return "z"
+
+
+def stat_entry(path, parent=None, name=None, deref=False):
+    try:
+        lst = os.lstat(path)
+        st = os.stat(path) if (deref or stat.S_ISLNK(lst.st_mode)) else lst
+    except OSError:
+        try:
+            lst = os.lstat(path); st = None
+        except OSError:
+            raise
+    return Entry(path, name if name is not None else os.path.basename(path.rstrip(os.sep)) or path, st, lst, parent)
+
+
+def natural_chunks(s, ignore_case):
+    if ignore_case: s = s.lower()
+    out = []
+    cur = ""
+    digit = None
+    for c in s:
+        d = c.isdigit()
+        if digit is None or d == digit:
+            cur += c; digit = d
+        else:
+            out.append(int(cur) if digit else cur); cur = c; digit = d
+    if cur:
+        out.append(int(cur) if digit else cur)
+    return out
+
+
+def cmp_entries(a, b, opt):
+    s = opt.sort
+    def cmp(x, y): return (x > y) - (x < y)
+    if s == "none": return 0
+    if s in ("name", "name_i"):
+        return cmp(natural_chunks(a.name, s.endswith("_i")), natural_chunks(b.name, s.endswith("_i")))
+    if s in ("dot", "dot_i"):
+        an = a.name[1:] if a.name.startswith(".") else a.name
+        bn = b.name[1:] if b.name.startswith(".") else b.name
+        return cmp(natural_chunks(an, s.endswith("_i")), natural_chunks(bn, s.endswith("_i")))
+    if s in ("ext", "ext_i"):
+        c = cmp(a.ext(), b.ext())
+        return c or cmp(natural_chunks(a.name, s.endswith("_i")), natural_chunks(b.name, s.endswith("_i")))
+    if s == "size": return cmp(a.size(), b.size())
+    if s == "modified": return cmp(a.mtime(), b.mtime())
+    if s == "age": return cmp(b.mtime(), a.mtime())
+    if s == "accessed": return cmp(a.atime(), b.atime())
+    if s == "changed": return cmp(a.ctime(), b.ctime())
+    if s == "created": return cmp(a.ctime(), b.ctime())
+    if s == "inode": return cmp(getattr(a.st, "st_ino", 0), getattr(b.st, "st_ino", 0))
+    if s == "type": return cmp(a.type_char_sort(), b.type_char_sort()) or cmp(natural_chunks(a.name, False), natural_chunks(b.name, False))
+    return cmp(a.name.lower(), b.name.lower())
+
+
+def sort_entries(entries, opt):
+    entries = sorted(entries, key=cmp_to_key(lambda a, b: cmp_entries(a, b, opt)))
+    if opt.reverse:
+        entries.reverse()
+    if opt.dirs_first:
+        entries = sorted(entries, key=lambda e: not e.points_to_dir())
+    elif opt.dirs_last:
+        entries = sorted(entries, key=lambda e: e.points_to_dir())
+    return entries
+
+
+def visible_name(name, opt):
+    if opt.no_quotes:
+        return name
+    if any(c.isspace() for c in name):
+        return '"' + name.replace('"', '\\"') + '"' if "'" in name else "'" + name + "'"
+    return name
+
+
+def display_name(e, opt, link_paths=True):
+    name = e.name
+    if e.parent is None and os.path.dirname(e.path) and e.path not in (".", ".."):
+        name = e.path
+    text = visible_name(name, opt)
+    if opt.classify in ("always", "auto"):
+        if e.is_dir(): text += "/"
+        elif e.is_link(): text += "@"
+        elif e.st and (e.st.st_mode & 0o111): text += "*"
+    if link_paths and e.is_link():
+        try:
+            text += " -> " + os.readlink(e.path)
+        except OSError:
+            pass
+    return text
+
+
+def read_dir(path, opt):
+    out = []
+    if opt.all_count >= 2:
+        for nm, p in [(".", path), ("..", os.path.join(path, ".."))]:
+            try: out.append(stat_entry(p, path, nm, opt.dereference))
+            except OSError: pass
+    try:
+        names = os.listdir(path)
+    except OSError as e:
+        raise e
+    show_dots = opt.all_count >= 1 or opt.almost_all
+    for nm in names:
+        if not show_dots and (nm.startswith(".") or (os.name == "nt" and nm.startswith("_"))):
+            continue
+        if any(fnmatch.fnmatchcase(nm, pat) for pat in opt.ignore_globs):
+            continue
+        p = os.path.join(path, nm)
+        try:
+            ent = stat_entry(p, path, nm, opt.dereference)
+        except OSError:
+            continue
+        if opt.only_dirs and not ent.is_dir() and not (opt.show_symlinks and ent.points_to_dir()):
+            continue
+        if opt.only_files and not ent.is_file() and not opt.recurse:
+            continue
+        if opt.no_symlinks and ent.is_link():
+            continue
+        out.append(ent)
+    return sort_entries(out, opt)
+
+
+def perm_string(e):
+    if e.st is None: return "----------"
+    m = e.lst.st_mode if e.lst else e.st.st_mode
+    t = "d" if stat.S_ISDIR(m) else "l" if stat.S_ISLNK(m) else "-"
+    bits = ""
+    for who in (6, 3, 0):
+        v = (m >> who) & 7
+        bits += "r" if v & 4 else "-"
+        bits += "w" if v & 2 else "-"
+        bits += "x" if v & 1 else "-"
+    return t + bits
+
+
+def size_string(e, opt):
+    if e.is_dir(): return "-"
+    n = e.size()
+    if opt.bytes: return str(n)
+    base = 1024 if opt.binary else 1000
+    units = ["", "K", "M", "G", "T"] if not opt.binary else ["", "Ki", "Mi", "Gi", "Ti"]
+    val = float(n); unit = units[0]
+    for unit in units:
+        if val < base or unit == units[-1]: break
+        val /= base
+    if unit == "": return str(n)
+    num = f"{val:.1f}" if val < 10 else str(int(round(val)))
+    return num + unit
+
+
+def time_string(e, opt):
+    ts = {"modified": e.mtime(), "changed": e.ctime(), "accessed": e.atime(), "created": e.ctime()}.get(opt.time_field, e.mtime())
+    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)
+    if opt.time_style == "long-iso": return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
+    if opt.time_style == "full-iso": return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f %z")
+    if opt.time_style == "iso": return dt.strftime("%m-%d %H:%M") if dt.year == datetime.now().year else dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
+    return dt.strftime("%e %b %H:%M" if dt.year == datetime.now().year else "%e %b  %Y").strip()
+
+
+def long_rows(entries, opt, tree_prefixes=None):
+    rows = []
+    for idx, e in enumerate(entries):
+        cells = []
+        if opt.inode: cells.append(str(getattr(e.st, "st_ino", 0)))
+        if not opt.no_permissions: cells.append(perm_string(e))
+        if opt.links: cells.append(str(getattr(e.st, "st_nlink", 0)))
+        if not opt.no_filesize: cells.append(size_string(e, opt))
+        if not opt.no_user:
+            cells.append(str(getattr(e.st, "st_uid", "-")) if opt.numeric or os.name == "nt" else user_name(getattr(e.st, "st_uid", 0)))
+        if opt.group: cells.append(str(getattr(e.st, "st_gid", "-")))
+        if not opt.no_time: cells.append(time_string(e, opt))
+        prefix = "" if tree_prefixes is None else tree_prefixes[idx]
+        rows.append((cells, prefix + display_name(e, opt)))
+    widths = []
+    for cells, _ in rows:
